notes:
## New

- What's new panel with release notes written from the commits since the last version
- Show tier badges on every platform, in the game hero and library
- Download multi-part mirrors, Datanodes, FuckingFast and FileKeeper
- List multi-part hoster mirrors as one download option
- Flatpak Proton tools and prefix setup for save backups
- Managed umu-run when none is installed, like upstream Hydra
- Find Proton in every Steam library like upstream Hydra
- Prepare a missing prefix before a save restore
- Run game installers through umu-run like upstream Hydra
- One game prefix for winetricks and save backups
- Wine fallback and stale prefix cleanup like upstream Hydra
- Supervise umu-run launches like upstream Hydra
- Parse umu-run output like upstream Hydra
- Map installer G: drive to the downloads folder
- Launch Windows games through umu-run and Proton
- Noctalia preset that follows the Linux desktop theme

## Fixed

- Retry failed lookups after 5 minutes and skip requests for cards that left the screen
- Steam shortcuts launch through Chimaera's run link
- Game shortcuts point at the AppImage file
- Detect Steam and Proton games correctly while playing
- Review fixes for the umu-run port
- Silence drop of a Copy result in installer exit hook
- Run host tools without the AppImage environment
- Stop status line bouncing as dots cycle
- Honor global GameMode and MangoHud switches
